memo:
EdgeHound Performance Review — June 25, 2026

The portfolio is down 14.77% since inception (-$1,477 on equity basis) with a Brier score of 0.245, indicating meaningful but imperfect calibration. The core finding remains unchanged: SHORT_FAVORITE on sports markets is the only statistically validated edge (69.1% win rate, n=134, 90% CI 63–76%). All other engines are either losing money or operating on insufficient sample sizes.

MOMENTUM remains disabled correctly — 8W/21 trades, -$1,019 PnL, a clear negative-edge engine with no redemptive signal. SMART_CONSENSUS has one trade at -$385; sample is too thin to evaluate but loss size relative to trades is alarming. VOLUME_SPIKE shows modest positive PnL (+$190) with 8W/20 trades — marginal but not clearly exploitable yet. ELITE_FOLLOW is slightly positive (+$82, 13W/27) with wallet 'denizz' scoring 0.8, suggesting selective follow logic may add value over time.

The recent soccer/football SHORT_FAVORITE trades (Morocco, Qatar, England spread markets) are generating noise — multiple max-hold exits near zero PnL and some small losses. These non-sports contexts hit the 'other' hypothesis bucket at only 47.8% win rate, barely above coin-flip. The bot is bleeding slowly on these.

Current config is appropriately conservative (kellyMult 0.13, maxExposure 0.35). I am making one targeted change: raising pMin to 0.62 to filter out the borderline soccer/draw-no-bet type markets that are eroding returns without edge confirmation. No other changes warranted this session — sample sizes remain thin on all non-sports engines.
observations: SHORT_FAVORITE on sports (baseball/tennis): 69.1% win rate, n=134, VALIDATED — primary alpha source
SHORT_FAVORITE on non-sports (soccer draws, spread bets, political): 47.8% win rate, n=21 — near coin-flip, actively diluting returns
MOMENTUM disabled correctly: 8W/21 trades, -$1,019 PnL, negative edge confirmed
SMART_CONSENSUS: 1 trade, -$385 — disabled, sample insufficient for re-evaluation
VOLUME_SPIKE: +$190 over 20 trades, 8W — slightly positive but thin; retain and monitor
ELITE_FOLLOW: +$82 over 27 trades — marginal positive; wallet 'denizz' scores 0.8, potential signal worth preserving
Brier score 0.245 is acceptable but room for calibration improvement, especially on non-sports markets
Several large stop-loss hits on SHORT_FAVORITE (Philadelphia Phillies, Houston Astros) suggest some favorites are genuinely overpriced in-market — model may not distinguish game-state correctly
Open positions skewed heavily SHORT_FAVORITE sports — healthy concentration given validated hypothesis
Soccer/draw/spread markets are generating near-zero or negative exits consistently — pMin filter should reduce entry frequency here
changesApplied: pMin capped at 0.6 (high-prior engines off; 0.62 would block all trades)
changeReasoning: Raising pMin from 0.60 to 0.62 to tighten the filter on marginal entries, particularly the soccer/draw/spread markets in the non-sports SHORT_FAVORITE bucket where win rate is 47.8% — well below profitable threshold. The validated sports SHORT_FAVORITE trades typically have pPredicted 0.67–0.72 and will still qualify. This change avoids disabling non-sports SHORT_FAVORITE entirely (sample n=21 is not yet definitive) while reducing trade frequency in unprofitable sub-context. All other parameters remain unchanged — kellyMult and maxExposure are appropriately conservative for a portfolio at -14.77% drawdown, and increasing bet size would be premature without seeing sustained positive expectation.
riskFlags: Repeated stop-loss hits on same matchup (Philadelphia Phillies x3, Houston Astros x2) suggest the bot may be re-entering positions on the same game from both sides — confirm deduplication logic is working correctly
ELITE_FOLLOW Colombia/DR Congo position: $450 stake on a single non-sports event is large relative to kelly sizing — check if ELITE_FOLLOW is bypassing normal sizing constraints
Non-sports SHORT_FAVORITE at 47.8% win rate is not yet statistically separable from random; continued exposure risks further equity erosion before hypothesis resolves
Overall equity at $8,523 (-14.77%) — if drawdown continues to -20% ($8,000), recommend halting all non-validated engines pending full review
Wallet 'aenews2' at 44% win rate (FORMING, n=14) — ELITE_FOLLOW should de-weight or exclude this wallet; confirm wallet-level filtering is active

configNow.comment: EdgeHound tunable parameters. The AI Analyst may adjust these within hard rails enforced in code. Humans can edit too. [pMin lowered to match surviving engines after momentum block]
